get.description:
Fast, DB-free health ping for reverse proxies, Docker healthchecks,
and cold-start pollers.
Readiness probe that checks database connectivity.

delete.description:
Deletes user account and cascades deletion of all documents, chunks, topics,
questions, dungeons, runs, attempts, and progress.
Protected: Any user with is_system=True (or username 'system_demo') cannot be deleted.
If req is provided, requires confirm == 'DELETE' if confirm key is sent.

post.description: Upgrades the current guest into a registered user in place (keeps user.id, public_id, points, runs).
Retries processing for a failed or interrupted document.

get.description:
Source preview citations: scoped to owner or public demo document.
Returns 1-based page numbers and stable chunk IDs.

Returns user aggregate metrics and mastery band:
Weak <50%, Learning 50-79%, Strong >=80%.
